newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria profit jumps - report.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria profit jumps - report.

text.p: Bank Austria, the country's largest bank, boosted its 1996 operating profit by as much as 20 percent, daily Kurier reported on Friday.
The report, which did not give a source, said the gain was due to substantially better trading profits, an improvement in the bank's international operations and tight cost management.
Bank Austria, which in January acquired majority control of competitor Creditanstalt for 17.2 billion schillings, reported a group operating profit of 5.338 billion schillings in 1995.
Kurier added that Creditanstalt itself was likely to report a 40 percent gain in operating profit from 6.138 billion schillings in 1995.
According to the report, both banks are likely to raise their respective dividends from ten schillings per share to twelve schillings per share each.
